purpose: Rebuild the GOLD_ML_V1 machine-learning lane as a causal, reproducible, regime-aware research system.

development_snapshot.rule: Only this exact snapshot may be used for MLR1-v1 development, feature selection, hyperparameter selection, calibration and policy-threshold selection.
development_snapshot.prospective_reservation: Rows outside this exact snapshot must never be merged back into MLR1-v1 development. They are reserved for shadow/prospective evaluation or a separately versioned MLR1-v2.

time_contract.entry_requirement: an exact M1 bar-open equal to decision time is required; otherwise skip
time_contract.higher_timeframe_join: use only H1/H4/D1 bars whose bar-close time is less than or equal to decision time

market_price_contract.long_entry: M1 bid open plus contemporaneous spread times point
market_price_contract.short_exit_and_touch_side: ask reconstructed as bid plus contemporaneous spread times point

primary_label_contract.entry_atr: M15 Wilder ATR14 calculated using the current closed M15 bar
primary_label_contract.time_exit: last available M1 close at or before the six-hour wall-clock horizon; never use a bar after the horizon
primary_label_contract.continuous_target: realized gross R under the frozen exit contract
primary_label_contract.change_rule: Any change to ATR period, target, stop, horizon, price-side handling or collision priority requires a new label ID and a new MLR version.

cost_contract.base: actual dynamic spread and no extra slippage
cost_contract.strong: 2x dynamic spread plus adverse entry and exit slippage of 0.10 USD-price per side
cost_contract.extreme: 3x dynamic spread plus adverse entry and exit slippage of 0.20 USD-price per side
cost_contract.label_path_uses: bid/ask-consistent actual spread; policy evaluation additionally applies the selected cost scenario

feature_contract.initial_model_form: tabular decision-time snapshot; no neural sequence model in the baseline stage
feature_families: dimensionless returns and momentum over fixed causal lookbacks
M15/H1/H4/D1 candle body, wick and range normalized by ATR
EMA gaps and slopes normalized by ATR
ATR-to-price, ATR short-to-long ratios and trailing ATR percentile
RSI, ADX and MACD normalized where price-scaled
Bollinger width divided by ATR and close location
distance to prior completed-day/week and trailing highs/lows divided by ATR
MT5 server hour and weekday cyclic encodings
feature_contract.indicator_rule: Causal indicators may include the current closed decision bar.
feature_contract.distribution_baseline_rule: Rolling percentiles, ranks, historical extrema and comparison baselines must exclude the current bar by shift(1).
feature_contract.missing_feature_policy: Do not impute across unavailable history. Exclude rows until all required causal warmups exist.

model_ladder.stage_3_sequence: TCN/LSTM may be evaluated only after the tabular model passes the frozen baseline gate and only if it produces material walk-forward improvement.
model_ladder.long_short_models: Separate LONG and SHORT estimators, calibration and diagnostics are required.

ev_contract.formula: P(TARGET)*1.5R + P(PROTECTIVE)*(-1.0R) + P(TIME)*E[TIME_R|x] minus scenario trading cost in R

policies.conservative: top 0.25 percent of eligible decisions per direction by calibrated strong-cost EV, with EV greater than zero
policies.standard: top 0.50 percent per direction by calibrated strong-cost EV, with EV greater than zero
policies.high_coverage: top 1.00 percent per direction by calibrated strong-cost EV, with EV greater than zero

folds.test: 2026-01-01 through the exact end of the frozen development snapshot

walk_forward_contract.historical_test_interpretation: development diagnosis only because the period has been inspected previously; it is not a pristine holdout

ml_metrics: ROC-AUC and PR-AUC for TARGET and PROTECTIVE
trading_metrics: signals and resolved trades by month
profit factor and mean R under base/strong/extreme cost
total R, maximum drawdown R and maximum losing streak
year, ATR regime, trend regime, session and spread regime breakdowns
evaluation_contract.no_primary_metric: No single AUC, PF or win-rate value is sufficient for acceptance.

shadow_gate.failure_result: remain research-only; do not begin prospective shadow signalling

prospective_contract.start: after a separately committed frozen model package passes the shadow gate
prospective_contract.data: only rows outside the frozen development snapshot
prospective_contract.model_update: A retrained model must receive a new immutable version ID.

stage_sequence: ML-06 calibration and strong-cost EV policies
